daily_comment.summary: Despite Saturday being a planned rest day ahead of Sunday's 19 km long run, Duarte completed both a gym session (Shoulders + Abs, 39 min) and an 8.0 km run at 6:11/km. The run HR averaged 162 bpm with a max of 174, indicating a moderate-to-hard effort rather than a true easy pace — this extra load the day before the long run is a recovery risk worth monitoring.
did_right: Completed the Shoulders + Abs gym session (39 min) that was planned for the week, keeping the strength block on track
Logged a solid 8.0 km at 6:11/km, contributing to weekly volume — 2 PRs achieved on Strava segments (Cabedelo–Salgueiros, Subida reserva bacalhau)
to_improve: Saturday was scheduled as a rest/active-recovery day before Sunday's 19 km long run — adding gym + run here reduces glycogen and increases fatigue; honour rest days that precede key sessions
Average HR of 162 bpm at 6:11/km is well above Zone 2 (target ≤ ~148 bpm for easy runs); slow down to 6:30–7:00/km on easy days to keep the aerobic stimulus without accumulating unnecessary stress
